canvas.loop: seamless: the last frame flows into the first (seam copies of start/end obstacles, HUD resets on the last frame, audio tail wrapped to the start)

video_encode.chunks: 318-frame chunks joined with the concat demuxer (-c copy)

rounds.course: helix funnel, radius 2.1 -> 1.15 m over 2 turns, CCW
rounds.obstacle: dark slab with a glowing top panel and 4 rivets

rounds.course: stairs, 2.4 m/s forward, 0.55 m sway every 3.2 s
helix funnel, radius 2.0 -> 1.3 m over 2 turns, CW
zigzag, 2.1 m/s forward, lateral step 1.9 m/s x hop time (0.22-0.95 m)
helix funnel, radius 2.1 -> 1.15 m over 2 turns, CCW
rounds.obstacle: lump of coal (displaced icosphere) with ember cracks

rounds.song: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rounds.course: stairs, 2.5 m/s forward, 0.45 m sway every 2.6 s

physics.arcs: exact ballistic arc between hits; obstacle normal = direction of the velocity change
physics.drop_per_hop: c * g * dt^2 / 2, c in [0.08, 0.92] chosen per hop for the round's target restitution (0.24-0.34)
physics.checks: 0 marble/obstacle penetrations, 0 obstacle overlaps, 0 rail hits
physics.rails: two 0.022 m tubes 0.23 m apart under the marble, U-shaped crossbars every 0.42 m; marble enters along its arrival velocity and leaves at +12 deg at the next round's speed (rolling energy, v^2 loses 0.9 m^2/s^2 per metre)

marble.post: warm glow halo (0.34) plus a 5-frame fading trail

glow.per_hit: emission 1.0 at the hit, 0.45 after 3 frames, 0.17 after 8, then 0.08 stays as a lit trail
glow.pop: obstacle dips 0.05 m along its normal over 1.5 frames and springs back by frame 7
glow.point_lights: 3 rotating, 0.55 m above the hit block, peak 90 W, gone after 13 frames

camera.helix_rounds: offset (0, -0.8, 5.6) m from the funnel axis at the marble's height, looking at it
camera.other_rounds: chase offset (1.6, 2.0, 5.6) m, looking at the marble + (0, -1.3, -0.9)
camera.smoothing: Gaussian, 0.35 s horizontal, 0.30 s vertical, 0.45 s between the two modes
camera.checks: 5 frames with the marble briefly hidden (funnel exits), never within 1.2 m of an obstacle

light.world: mood fog colour x 1.0-1.3, changes over 0.7 s around each round start

fog: in every material: mix to the mood colour by 1 - exp(-(d - 9 m) / 34 m), max 0.93

render.off: soft shadows, AO, bloom, SSR, motion blur (all too slow on software GL or done in post)
render.speed: about 3.3 s per frame on 2 CPU cores, ~1 h 45 min for the whole video

post.backdrop: mood display colour, brightest (x1.35) just below centre, x0.45 at the corners
post.bokeh: 17 soft discs, radius 40-125 px, red/gold/green/white, screen blend 0.10-0.22, drifting and breathing on loop-periodic paths
post.bloom: pixels whose max channel > 168, blurred 5 px and 16 px at quarter size, added x0.75 and x0.55
post.snow: 120 flakes, radius 1.4-5.2 px, 2-7 screen heights per loop (bigger falls faster)

hud.font: Montserrat variable (falls back to Poppins ExtraBold/Bold)

dots.current: x1.38 with a team-colour glow, +14% pulse on every hit

hud.reset: labels and dots fade out over the last 0.22 s

audio.melody: one note per marble hit: additive piano (8 partials, slight inharmonicity) plus a glockenspiel sparkle an octave up; celesta for Sugar Plum

backing.trap: 808 bass with pitch drop, saw pad, 8th hats with rolls, clap on beat 3
backing.pop: kick 1+3, snare 2+4, plucked bass, e-piano stabs, sleigh bells on every beat and offbeat
backing.pizz: pizzicato root/fifth on quarters and chord plucks on offbeats, a tick, light sleigh bells
backing.dark: kick 1+3 (+ ghost), clap 2+4, low pad, 8th hats
backing.waltz: bass on 1, e-piano chords and sleigh bells on 2 and 3

audio.rails: low rolling noise with a 23 Hz wobble and a landing click
audio.reverb: 1.9 s noise IR (decay 0.42 s), send mix
audio.loudness: about -14 dBFS RMS, peak -1 dBFS (tanh soft clip)
audio.sync: audio onsets land within 7 ms of the hit times (median 1.6 ms), well under a 33 ms frame
